title: Ol Ba'uu Abjuu
intro: Lubbuun guddummaaf murtaa’e, garuu qormaata cimaadhaan qoramte, imala adda ta’e tokkotti seente. Daandiin nama dhuunfaa kanaa hinaaffaa, addaan ba’uu fi gidiraa haqa hin qabneen kan mallatteeffame yoo ta’u, itti gaafatamummaa guddaa fi walitti dhufeenya gadi fagoo ta’een qofa kan xumurame ture. Qur'aana keessaa nama dinqisiisaa kana adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Yeroo tokko namoota baayʼee natti dhihoo taʼaniin kan na hinaafe siʼa taʼu, kunis warra koo fi mana koo irraa baayʼee akkan adda baʼu godheera.
Imaltoonni gatii xiqqaadhaan gurguramuu dabalatee yeroon rakkina guddaa na mudate.
Haqa malee badii hojjedheera jedhamee kan himatamee fi waggoota hedduudhaaf hidhaa keessa kanan ture taʼus, amantiin koo hin raafamne.
Mul’ata walxaxaa ta’e hiikuuf dandeettiin addaa naaf kenname, kunis daandii bilisummaa kootiif meeshaa ta’uu isaa mirkaneesse.
Ogummaa fi amanamummaan koo yeroo booda biyya ormaa irratti aangoo guddaa fi amanannaa guddaa akkan qabaadhu na taasise.
Taateewwan walduraa duubaan raawwatamaniin, yeroo dheeraa fi dhukkubsataa taʼeen erga hin argamnee booda, warra koo maanguddoota taʼanii fi obbolaa koo wajjin deebiʼee wal arge.

outcome.answer: Gibxii keessatti tajaajilaa humna guddaa qabu ta'uu

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
